metadata.description: Name of the target Log Analytics Workspace hosting Microsoft Sentinel.

properties.displayName: Azure Activity - Privileged Role Assignment or Resource Deletion Spike
properties.description:
Detects suspicious control plane activity in Azure, specifically the assignment of high-privilege RBAC roles
(Owner, Contributor, User Access Administrator) or an abnormal spike in resource deletion operations (>= 5 in lookback).
Adversaries assign privileged roles for persistence (T1098.003) and delete cloud resources for denial of service (T1485).
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 30m overlap with PT30M frequency to absorb cloud activity ingestion delays
let lookback = 1h;
let privRoles = dynamic([
    "8e3af657-a8ff-443c-a75c-2fe8c4bcb635", // Owner
    "b24988ac-6180-42a0-ab88-20f7382dd24c", // Contributor
    "18d7d88d-d35e-4fb5-a5c3-7773c20a72d9"  // User Access Administrator
]);
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Succeeded")
| extend Body = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(Properties).requestbody))
| extend RoleDefId = tostring(Body.Properties.RoleDefinitionId),
         PrincipalId = tostring(Body.Properties.PrincipalId)
| extend IsPrivRole = OperationNameValue =~ "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write" and RoleDefId has_any (privRoles)
| extend IsDelete = OperationNameValue endswith "/delete" and not(OperationNameValue has_any ("locks", "diagnostics", "tags"))
| where IsPrivRole or IsDelete
| summarize
    PrivRoleGrants = countif(IsPrivRole),
    DeletesCount = countif(IsDelete),
    AssignedPrincipals = make_set(PrincipalId, 10),
    TargetResources = make_set(Resource, 10),
    StartTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Caller, CallerIpAddress, SubscriptionId
| where PrivRoleGrants > 0 or DeletesCount >= 5
| extend CallerName = iff(Caller has "@", tostring(split(Caller, "@")[0]), Caller),
         CallerUPNSuffix = iff(Caller has "@", tostring(split(Caller, "@")[1]), ""),
         PrincipalsStr = tostring(AssignedPrincipals),
         ResourcesStr = tostring(TargetResources)
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    Caller,
    CallerName,
    CallerUPNSuffix,
    CallerIpAddress,
    SubscriptionId,
    PrivRoleGrants,
    DeletesCount,
    PrincipalsStr,
    ResourcesStr

properties.description:
Detects non-machine accounts executing Directory Service replication operations (Event ID 4662)
requesting both DS-Replication-Get-Changes and DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All extended rights.
Adversaries use tools like Mimikatz (lsadump::dcsync) or Impacket secretsdump to extract domain password hashes.
Prerequisite: Requires an Active Directory Domain Controller with 'Audit Directory Service Access' enabled and a root domain SACL.
properties.query:
// Single-pass correlation of 4662 (DCSync) and 4624 (Network Logon) avoids self-join overhead
let lookback = 30m;
let g1 = "1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2"; // DS-Replication-Get-Changes
let g2 = "1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2"; // DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where (EventID == 4662 and ObjectServer == "DS" and AccessMask == "0x100"
         and SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
         and not(SubjectUserName startswith "MSOL_")
         and not(SubjectUserName startswith "AAD_")
         and Properties has_any (g1, g2))
     or (EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 3)
| extend LogonId = iff(EventID == 4662, SubjectLogonId, TargetLogonId),
         CleanIP = replace_string(IpAddress, "::ffff:", "")
| summarize
    GetChanges = countif(EventID == 4662 and Properties has g1),
    GetChangesAll = countif(EventID == 4662 and Properties has g2),
    SubjectUserName = take_anyif(SubjectUserName, EventID == 4662),
    SubjectDomainName = take_anyif(SubjectDomainName, EventID == 4662),
    SourceIP = take_anyif(CleanIP, EventID == 4624 and CleanIP !in ("", "-")),
    SourceHost = take_anyif(WorkstationName, EventID == 4624 and WorkstationName !in ("", "-")),
    StartTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime = max(TimeGenerated)
    by LogonId, DC = Computer
| where GetChanges > 0 and GetChangesAll > 0
| extend SourceHostClean = iff(isempty(SourceHost) or SourceHost == "-", DC, SourceHost)
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    DC,
    SubjectUserName,
    SubjectDomainName,
    SubjectLogonId = LogonId,
    SourceIP,
    SourceHostClean,
    GetChanges,
    GetChangesAll

properties.displayName: Multiple Defender / SecurityAlerts on Same Host or Account
properties.description:
Correlates multiple security alerts (from Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Identity, or Cloud) occurring
on the same host or user account within a 1-hour period. Excludes Sentinel-generated alerts to prevent recursion,
deduplicates status-update events by SystemAlertId, and requires 3+ distinct alert definitions.
properties.query:
// Overlapping 1h lookback with 15m frequency ensures correlated alerts across boundary are evaluated
let lookback = 1h;
let alertCountThreshold = 3;
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where ProductName != "Azure Sentinel" // Exclude Sentinel alerts to prevent recursive feedback loops
| where AlertSeverity in ("Medium", "High", "Critical")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId // Deduplicate alert status updates
| where isnotempty(CompromisedEntity) and CompromisedEntity !in~ ("Unknown", "-", "None")
| extend NormalizedEntity = tolower(CompromisedEntity)
| summarize
    TotalAlerts = count(),
    DistinctAlertNames = dcount(AlertName),
    AlertList = make_set(AlertName, 10),
    Severities = make_set(AlertSeverity, 5),
    Products = make_set(ProductName, 5),
    StartTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime = max(TimeGenerated)
    by NormalizedEntity
| where DistinctAlertNames >= alertCountThreshold
| extend AlertListStr = tostring(AlertList),
         ProductsStr = tostring(Products),
         TargetHost = iff(NormalizedEntity !has "@", NormalizedEntity, ""),
         TargetAccount = iff(NormalizedEntity has "@", NormalizedEntity, "")
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    NormalizedEntity,
    TargetHost,
    TargetAccount,
    TotalAlerts,
    DistinctAlertNames,
    AlertList,
    Severities,
    Products,
    AlertListStr,
    ProductsStr

properties.description:
Detects the execution of PowerShell with base64-encoded command parameters (e.g., -enc, -encodedcommand,
or FromBase64String) using regex to catch dash variants and parameter abbreviations.
Prerequisite: Requires Windows GPO 'Include command line in process creation events' enabled for Event ID 4688.
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 15m overlap with PT15M frequency
let lookback = 30m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4688 and isnotempty(CommandLine)
| extend ProcessBase = tostring(split(Process, @"\")[ -1])
| where ProcessBase in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s[-/–—]e(c|n[a-z]*)?\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}"
     or CommandLine contains "frombase64string"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Computer,
    SubjectUserName,
    SubjectDomainName,
    Process,
    CommandLine,
    ParentProcessName

properties.displayName: Entra ID Risky Sign-in - Identity Protection Signal or Anomalous Travel
properties.description:
Detects anomalous Entra ID (Azure AD) sign-ins flagged with elevated risk levels or suspicious signals
(unlikely travel, anomalous token, unfamiliar features, anonymized IP) in SigninLogs.
Prerequisite: Requires Microsoft Entra ID P2 license for Identity Protection risk event population.
properties.query:
// Overlapping 2h lookback with 1h frequency ensures late-arriving cloud audit logs are ingested
let lookback = 2h;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where ResultType == 0
| extend CleanIP = replace_string(IPAddress, "::ffff:", "")
| extend City = tostring(LocationDetails.city),
         Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| extend RiskEventTypes = tostring(RiskEventTypes_V2),
         RiskLevel = tostring(RiskLevelDuringSignIn)
| where RiskLevel in ("high", "medium") or RiskEventTypes has_any ("unlikelyTravel", "anonymizedIPAddress", "maliciousIPAddress", "unfamiliarFeatures", "suspiciousBrowser")
| summarize
    SignInCount = count(),
    DistinctLocations = make_set(strcat(City, ", ", Country), 10),
    DistinctIPs = make_set(CleanIP, 10),
    DistinctApps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10),
    ObservedRiskEvents = make_set(RiskEventTypes, 10),
    ObservedRiskLevels = make_set(RiskLevel, 5),
    LatestIP = take_any(CleanIP),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by UserPrincipalName, UserId
| extend AccountName = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[0]),
         UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[1]),
         LocationsStr = tostring(DistinctLocations),
         RiskEventsStr = tostring(ObservedRiskEvents)
| project
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    UserPrincipalName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    UserId,
    LatestIP,
    SignInCount,
    DistinctLocations,
    DistinctIPs,
    DistinctApps,
    LocationsStr,
    RiskEventsStr

properties.displayName: Kerberoasting - TGS Request with RC4 Encryption (4769)
properties.description:
Detects suspicious Kerberos Ticket Granting Service (TGS) ticket requests (Event ID 4769) utilizing
weak RC4 encryption (0x17, 0x18) across multiple distinct Service Principal Names (SPNs).
Adversaries request tickets for Active Directory SPNs using RC4 to crack service account passwords offline (T1558.003).
Prerequisite: Requires an Active Directory Domain Controller with 'Audit Kerberos Service Ticket Operations' enabled.
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 15m overlap with PT15M frequency
let lookback = 30m;
// Lab threshold: 3 distinct SPNs; baseline and tune for enterprise service account traffic
let distinctSpnThreshold = 3;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4769
| extend EventDataStr = tostring(EventData)
| extend TicketEncryptionType = tostring(column_ifexists("TicketEncryptionType", "")),
         ServiceName = tostring(column_ifexists("ServiceName", "")),
         Status = tostring(column_ifexists("Status", ""))
| extend TicketEncryptionType = iff(isempty(TicketEncryptionType), extract('<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventDataStr), TicketEncryptionType),
         ServiceName = iff(isempty(ServiceName), extract('<Data Name="ServiceName">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventDataStr), ServiceName),
         Status = iff(isempty(Status), extract('<Data Name="Status">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventDataStr), Status)
| where Status == "0x0"
| where TicketEncryptionType in ("0x17", "0x18") // RC4-HMAC and RC4-EXP
| where ServiceName !endswith "$" and ServiceName !in~ ("krbtgt", "kadmin/changepw")
| where TargetUserName !has "$@" and TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ClientIP = replace_string(IpAddress, "::ffff:", "")
| where ClientIP !in ("", "-", "::1", "127.0.0.1")
| summarize
    RequestCount = count(),
    DistinctSPNs = dcount(ServiceName),
    RequestedServices = make_set(ServiceName, 20),
    TargetDCs = make_set(Computer, 5),
    StartTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime = max(TimeGenerated)
    by TargetUserName, ClientIP
| where DistinctSPNs >= distinctSpnThreshold
| extend AccountName = tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0]),
         UPNSuffix = tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[1]),
         RequestedServicesStr = tostring(RequestedServices)
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    TargetUserName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    ClientIP,
    RequestCount,
    DistinctSPNs,
    RequestedServices,
    RequestedServicesStr

properties.description:
Detects the abuse of Living-off-the-Land Binaries (LOLBins) including certutil.exe (remote file download/decoding),
mshta.exe (inline script or remote HTA execution), and rundll32.exe (comsvcs minidump or URL protocol execution).
Prerequisite: Requires Windows GPO 'Include command line in process creation events' enabled for Event ID 4688.
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 15m overlap with PT15M frequency
let lookback = 30m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4688 and isnotempty(CommandLine)
| extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(Process, @"\")[ -1])),
         Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where (Bin =~ "certutil.exe" and Cmd matches regex @"[-/](urlcache|verifyctl|decode|decodehex)")
     or (Bin =~ "mshta.exe" and Cmd has_any ("http://", "https://", "javascript:", "vbscript:", ".hta"))
     or (Bin =~ "rundll32.exe" and (Cmd has_any ("javascript:", "url.dll,fileprotocolhandler")
                                    or (Cmd has "comsvcs" and Cmd has "minidump")))
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Computer,
    SubjectUserName,
    SubjectDomainName,
    Process,
    CommandLine,
    ParentProcessName

properties.displayName: LSASS Memory Access - Sysmon Event ID 10
properties.description:
Detects non-standard processes opening handles to the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (lsass.exe)
memory space with rights indicative of credential dumping (e.g., Mimikatz, ProcDump, Dumpert, or TaskMgr).
Monitors Sysmon Event ID 10 (ProcessAccess) filtered against legitimate security engines.
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 15m overlap with PT15M frequency to prevent ingestion lag drops
let lookback = 30m;
Event
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 10
| parse EventData with * '<Data Name="SourceImage">' SourceImage '</Data>' *
                        '<Data Name="TargetImage">' TargetImage '</Data>' *
                        '<Data Name="GrantedAccess">' GrantedAccess '</Data>' *
                        '<Data Name="CallTrace">' CallTrace '</Data>' *
| where TargetImage endswith @"\lsass.exe"
| where not(SourceImage startswith @"C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\"
            or SourceImage startswith @"C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\"
            or SourceImage startswith @"C:\Program Files\Microsoft Defender\")
| where GrantedAccess in~ ("0x1010", "0x1410", "0x1438", "0x143a", "0x1fffff", "0x1f3fff")
| extend SourceUser = extract('<Data Name="SourceUser">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventData)
| extend EffectiveUser = iff(isempty(SourceUser), UserName, SourceUser)
| extend ActorDomain = tostring(split(EffectiveUser, @"\")[0]),
         ActorName = tostring(split(EffectiveUser, @"\")[ -1])
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Computer,
    SourceImage,
    TargetImage,
    GrantedAccess,
    CallTrace,
    ActorName,
    ActorDomain

properties.displayName: Mass File Deletion - Potential Ransomware or Wiper Activity
properties.description:
Detects an unusually rapid burst of file deletion operations initiated by a user-space process.
This burst activity is characteristic of ransomware wiping shadow copies and original files, or wiper malware
causing data destruction (T1485). Monitors Sysmon Event IDs 23 (FileDelete) and 26 (FileDeleteDetected).
properties.query:
// Lab threshold set to 30; baseline and raise to 100+ for production workstations
let threshold = 30;
let lookback = 15m;
let benignPaths = dynamic([
    @"C:\Windows\System32\cleanmgr.exe",
    @"C:\Windows\System32\msiexec.exe",
    @"C:\Windows\System32\TiWorker.exe",
    @"C:\Windows\servicing\TrustedInstaller.exe"
]);
Event
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID in (23, 26)
| parse EventData with * '<Data Name="User">' ExecutingUser '</Data>' *
                        '<Data Name="Image">' InitiatingProcess '</Data>' *
                        '<Data Name="TargetFilename">' TargetFile '</Data>' *
| where not(InitiatingProcess in~ (benignPaths))
| summarize
    DeletedFilesCount = count(),
    SampleFiles = make_set(TargetFile, 10),
    StartTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Computer, InitiatingProcess, ExecutingUser
| where DeletedFilesCount >= threshold
| extend ActorDomain = tostring(split(ExecutingUser, @"\")[0]),
         ActorName = tostring(split(ExecutingUser, @"\")[ -1]),
         SampleFilesStr = tostring(SampleFiles)
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    Computer,
    InitiatingProcess,
    ActorName,
    ActorDomain,
    DeletedFilesCount,
    SampleFiles,
    SampleFilesStr

properties.displayName: Entra ID - MFA Disabled or Strong Auth Method Removed
properties.description:
Detects when Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is disabled or strong authentication methods (FIDO2 keys,
Authenticator apps, phone methods) are removed for a user in Entra ID (AuditLogs).
Focuses on administrative resets and deletions to identify persistent access setup by compromised administrators (T1556.006).
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 1h overlap with PT1H frequency for cloud audit log latency
let lookback = 2h;
let sensitiveOperations = dynamic([
    "Delete strong authentication method",
    "Disable Strong Authentication",
    "Admin deleted security info",
    "Delete authentication method"
]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where Result =~ "success"
| where OperationName in~ (sensitiveOperations)
| extend ActorUser = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         ActorApp  = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
         ActorIP   = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| extend Actor = coalesce(ActorUser, ActorApp)
| mv-expand tr = TargetResources
| where tostring(tr.type) =~ "User"
| extend TargetUser = tostring(tr.userPrincipalName)
| extend TargetUserName = tostring(split(TargetUser, "@")[0]),
         TargetUPNSuffix = tostring(split(TargetUser, "@")[1]),
         ActorName = tostring(split(ActorUser, "@")[0]),
         ActorUPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorUser, "@")[1])
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    OperationName,
    Actor,
    ActorName,
    ActorUPNSuffix,
    ActorIP,
    TargetUser,
    TargetUserName,
    TargetUPNSuffix,
    ResultReason,
    Category

properties.displayName: Password Spray - Many Users Few Failures Each
properties.description:
Detects horizontal password spraying where an attacker tests a small number of passwords across multiple
distinct accounts from a single source IP. Specifically enforces that targeted accounts experience few failures each
(MaxPerUser <= 5) across multiple users (DistinctUsers >= 5) to distinguish spraying from vertical brute force.
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 30m overlap with PT30M frequency
let lookback = 1h;
// Lab threshold: 5 distinct users; baseline and tune for enterprise perimeter environments
let distinctUserThreshold = 5;
let maxFailuresPerUser = 5;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4625
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend RawIP = iff(IpAddress in ("", "-"), WorkstationName, IpAddress)
| extend SourceIP = replace_string(RawIP, "::ffff:", "")
| where SourceIP !in ("", "-", "127.0.0.1", "::1", "Unknown")
| summarize
    UserFailures = count(),
    FirstEvent = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated),
    DCs = make_set(Computer, 5)
    by SourceIP, TargetUserName
| summarize
    DistinctUsers = dcount(TargetUserName),
    TotalFailures = sum(UserFailures),
    MaxPerUser = max(UserFailures),
    TargetedUsersList = make_set(TargetUserName, 50),
    TargetDCs = make_set(DCs, 5),
    StartTime = min(FirstEvent),
    EndTime = max(LastEvent)
    by SourceIP
| where DistinctUsers >= distinctUserThreshold and MaxPerUser <= maxFailuresPerUser
| extend UsersStr = tostring(TargetedUsersList)
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    SourceIP,
    DistinctUsers,
    TotalFailures,
    MaxPerUser,
    UsersStr

properties.description:
Detects when an account is added to a high-privilege local or Active Directory security group
(Event IDs 4728 for global groups, 4732 for local groups, and 4756 for universal groups).
Monitors well-known administrative SIDs and RIDs to ensure resilience across localized Windows OS versions.
Prerequisite: Requires 'Audit Security Group Management' enabled in Windows Audit Policy.
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 15m overlap with PT15M frequency
let lookback = 30m;
let builtinSids = dynamic([
    "S-1-5-32-544", // Administrators
    "S-1-5-32-548", // Account Operators
    "S-1-5-32-549", // Server Operators
    "S-1-5-32-551"  // Backup Operators
]);
let privilegedGroupNames = dynamic([
    "Administrators",
    "Domain Admins",
    "Enterprise Admins",
    "Schema Admins",
    "Account Operators",
    "Backup Operators",
    "Server Operators",
    "DnsAdmins"
]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where EventID in (4728, 4732, 4756)
| where TargetSid in (builtinSids)
     or TargetSid matches regex @"-(512|518|519)$" // Domain Admins, Schema Admins, Enterprise Admins
     or TargetUserName in~ (privilegedGroupNames)
| extend AddedMember = iff(MemberName in ("", "-"), MemberSid, MemberName)
| extend AddedMemberName = iff(AddedMember has @"\", tostring(split(AddedMember, @"\")[ -1]), AddedMember)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Computer,
    EventID,
    TargetGroup = TargetUserName,
    AddedMember,
    AddedMemberName,
    ActorAccount = SubjectUserName,
    ActorDomain = SubjectDomainName,
    Activity

properties.description:
Detects the creation of a new Windows scheduled task (Event ID 4698) where the executed command or arguments
reference suspicious directory paths (e.g., AppData, Temp, Users\Public) or scripting engines.
Prerequisite: Requires advanced audit policy 'Audit Other Object Access Events' enabled in Windows GPO.
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 15m overlap with PT15M frequency
let lookback = 30m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4698
| extend TaskName = extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventData),
         TaskContent = extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventData)
| extend Command = extract(@'<Command>(.*?)</Command>', 1, TaskContent),
         Arguments = extract(@'<Arguments>(.*?)</Arguments>', 1, TaskContent)
| extend FullExecution = strcat(Command, " ", Arguments)
| where FullExecution matches regex @"(?i)(\\(appdata|temp|perflogs)\\|\\users\\public\\)"
     or Command matches regex @"(?i)(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|certutil|bitsadmin)\.exe"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Computer,
    SubjectUserName,
    SubjectDomainName,
    TaskName,
    Command,
    Arguments,
    FullExecution

properties.description:
Detects the installation of a new Windows service (System Event ID 7045) executing from suspicious directories
(Temp, AppData, Users\Public), UNC admin shares, or invoking command interpreters (PsExec, cmd.exe, %COMSPEC%, PowerShell).
Adversaries install services for persistence (T1543.003) and remote lateral movement execution (T1569.002).
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 15m overlap with PT15M frequency
let lookback = 30m;
Event
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where EventLog == "System" and EventID == 7045
| extend ServiceName = extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventData),
         ImagePath = extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventData),
         ServiceType = extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceType">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventData),
         StartType = extract(@'<Data Name="StartType">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventData),
         ServiceAccount = extract(@'<Data Name="AccountName">(.*?)</Data>', 1, EventData)
| where ImagePath matches regex @"(?i)(\\(appdata|temp|perflogs)\\|\\users\\public\\|^\\\\|admin\$|%comspec%|psexesvc)"
     or ImagePath has_any ("powershell", "pwsh", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "certutil.exe")
| extend ActorDomain = tostring(split(ServiceAccount, @"\")[0]),
         ActorName = tostring(split(ServiceAccount, @"\")[ -1])
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Computer,
    ServiceName,
    ImagePath,
    ServiceType,
    StartType,
    ServiceAccount,
    ActorName,
    ActorDomain

properties.displayName: Windows Brute Force - Multiple Failed Logons (4625)
properties.description:
Detects an abnormal spike of failed logon attempts (Windows Security Event ID 4625) targeting
the same user account from a single source within a lookback window. Filters out batch (4) and service (5)
logons to eliminate noise from stale scheduled tasks and service account credentials.
properties.query:
// Lookback window provides 15m overlap with PT15M frequency
let lookback = 30m;
// Lab threshold: 5 failed attempts; baseline to 10+ for external RDP or multi-tier enterprise servers
let threshold = 5;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4625
| where LogonType !in (4, 5) // Exclude batch (4) and service (5) logon failures
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend RawIP = iff(IpAddress in ("", "-"), WorkstationName, IpAddress)
| extend SourceIP = replace_string(RawIP, "::ffff:", "")
| where SourceIP !in ("", "-", "127.0.0.1", "::1", "Unknown")
| summarize
    FailedAttempts = count(),
    StartTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime = max(TimeGenerated),
    LogonTypes = make_set(LogonType),
    SubStatusReasons = make_set(SubStatus)
    by TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, SourceIP, Computer
| where FailedAttempts >= threshold
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    TargetUserName,
    TargetDomainName,
    SourceIP,
    Computer,
    FailedAttempts,
    LogonTypes,
    SubStatusReasons
